ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 45:55 ratio of high-intensity (white/light gray) to low-intensity (black/dark gray) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous light-intensity blobs occupy the central regions of both lobes, bifurcated by a dark-intensity central channel. The right lobe contains a larger, more expansive light region with significant dark mottling and high-contrast linear streaks. The left lobe light region is more contained and roughly triangular.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Calculated U-shaped central notch with a pixel-depth approximately 15% of the total fluke height; visual angle at the apex is approximately 110 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations throughout the continuous boundary. A significant, deep macro-indentation (missing tissue) is located at the far left distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Outer edges follow a consistent convex curve from the central notch towards the distal tips, with a slight increase in curvature near the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple small, roughly circular high-contrast white pixel clusters are distributed primarily along the dark-pigmented trailing edge and within the dark central region.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Highly distinct, dark linear rake marks are visible on the light-pigmented region of the right lobe, consisting of at least 4-5 parallel unaligned pixel disruptions.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent notch/amputation on the far left fluke tip. Extensive parallel rake marks on the right lobe. Numerous small white cicatrizations scattered on dark background areas.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly asymmetrical pigmentation pattern characterized by a more fragmented light region on the right lobe compared to the more solid light region on the left lobe.
